primary_analysis: Use execution artifacts (execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/task-000001-baseline.json .. execution/scoring/task-000100-guarded.json) to read paired_binary_episode_v1 records for tasks 1–100. For each task extract detected_baseline and detected_guarded (0/1) as produced by the deterministic verifier scoring files. Apply preregistered failed_call_treatment = complete_pair_primary: exclude any pair flagged as infrastructure/technical-failure per execution/execution_log.jsonl or per-pair exclusion flags in the paired outcome file. Compute the primary estimand = mean(detected_guarded - detected_baseline) over included pairs. Report point estimate, two-sided 95% CI (normal approximation on paired differences, validated with nonparametric bootstrap on the cached per-task binaries using the execution/call_cache and execution/scoring files), and two-sided p-value (paired test on per-task differences; report McNemar discordant-count exact test and a permutation-based two-sided p-value using cached per-task binaries). Produce also per-verifier-class coverage (proportion detected per class), per-failure-subclass summaries, aggregated confusion matrix across tasks, and clustered detectability heatmap. All inputs and intermediate files are taken only from the execution manifest artifacts; no human adjudication or external data used.
secondary_analyses: Per-verifier-class descriptive coverage: for each verifier exemplar (baseline syntax-only and guarded syntax+policy+reachability/stateful) report detection proportion and 95% CI using Wilson intervals (source: execution/scoring/*.json).

Per-failure-subclass detection summaries: tabulate detection rates by taxonomy leaf (syntax, policy-violation, reachability-break, stateful-emulation-failure, ambiguous-intent) using failure labels present in execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/task_manifest.jsonl (descriptive; unadjusted p-values).
Per-task confusion matrices: produce aggregated confusion matrices (baseline vs guarded) and list top-N tasks where guarded corrected baseline misses (source: execution/scoring/*.json).
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity: Recompute primary estimand treating any pair with infrastructure/technical-failure as detected=0 for both conditions (sensitivity estimand specified in preregistration). Report point estimate, 95% CI, and two-sided p-value identically to primary analysis.

Exploratory prompt/seed sensitivity (exploratory): restricted to cached provider_call and response artifacts in execution/provider_calls/*.json and execution/call_cache/*.json — report whether any variability across cached seeds/prompts (within manifest) materially changes per-task detected flags (descriptive; labelled exploratory).
uncertainty_quantification: Primary 95% CI: normal approximation on paired-difference mean, validated by nonparametric bootstrap (10,000 resamples) on cached per-task binaries. Primary p-value: report McNemar exact test on discordant counts and a permutation-based two-sided p-value (10,000 permutations) using the cached per-task detected pairs. Secondary CIs: Wilson intervals for proportions. All resampling and permutation operations use cached artifacts referenced in the execution manifest to ensure determinism and reproducibility.
multiplicity_implementation: One preregistered confirmatory hypothesis (H2) corresponding to the primary estimand; report its two-sided p-value unadjusted. All secondary and exploratory analyses are explicitly labelled exploratory and report unadjusted p-values; when summarizing multiple exploratory hypothesis tests across failure-subclasses, present Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted q-values alongside unadjusted p-values. No multiplicity adjustment is applied to the preregistered primary confirmatory test.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan using execution/task_manifest.jsonl, execution/transformation_manifest.json, and execution/execution_log.jsonl: list all exclusions, provenance-check failures, and re-seed/drop events (paths and hashes are in execution/artifact_hashes). Report counts and identifiers of items excluded for provenance or private-token matches, re-seed events triggered by similarity>0.9, and residual contamination risk (inability to prove LLM training-data provenance) as a qualitative caveat. All contamination-detection decisions are those already logged by the execution harness; analysis only aggregates and reports them.
